pages.text: You find that the protection your robes offer to their respective servants is still insufficient, after all, you cannot wear multiple robes at once. You have devised a trinket that provides more effective protection for your servants. When enchanted with Persistence, your servants even have a chance to survive death.
This charm can also accept other focus enchantments. When enchanted with Potency or Velocity, it provides buffs to your servants when you cast necromancy spells.
What is the reversal of all living things? Strange for eons, even death eventually passes.
